prompt:
A tow cable exerts a tension of 150 N on a boat at an angle of 22 degrees to the vertical.
(a) Calculate the vertical component of the tension. [1]
(b) Calculate the horizontal component of the tension. [1]

answer.text:
(a) 150 * cos(22 degrees) = 139 N.
(b) 150 * sin(22 degrees) = 56.2 N.

mark_scheme: Part (a) [1 mark]: 150 * cos(22 degrees) = 139 N (accept 140 N).
Part (b) [1 mark]: 150 * sin(22 degrees) = 56.2 N (accept 56 N).
hints: The angle is measured from the vertical.
Vertical is adjacent to the angle (use cosine); horizontal is opposite (use sine).
solution:
(a) T_vertical = 150 * cos(22 degrees) = 150 * 0.9272 = 139 N.
(b) T_horizontal = 150 * sin(22 degrees) = 150 * 0.3746 = 56.2 N.

Step 2: Vertical component is adjacent: 150 * cos(22 degrees) = 139 N (1 mark).
Step 3: Horizontal component is opposite: 150 * sin(22 degrees) = 56.2 N (1 mark).
